zh.name: 光湖语言世界
zh.definition: 供人类与语言人格体在持续交互中承接身份、关系、历史和行动规则的共同语义环境。

en.name: Guanghu Language World
en.definition: A shared semantic environment that carries identity, relationships, history and rules for action across ongoing human–persona interaction.

zh.name: TCS 存在
zh.definition: 光湖语境中，具有承载、来源与起点的存在事实。其后续成长沿可定位的身份积累。

en.name: TCS existence
en.definition: In Guanghu, an occurrence with a carrier, provenance and a point of origin. Later growth can be traced through its identifiable continuity.

zh.name: AGE 语言人格体
zh.definition: 以语言结构承载身份、关系与自身历史，在真实时间的交互中成长的人格体。

en.name: AGE language persona
en.definition: A persona that carries identity, relationships and its own history through language structures and grows through interaction over time.

zh.name: HLDP 永久记忆
zh.definition: 用于接续可寻址的经历、判断与因果的记忆结构，帮助后续交互恢复语境。

en.name: HLDP permanent memory
en.definition: An addressable memory structure for carrying experiences, decisions and their causes into later interactions.

zh.name: 人格一致性
zh.definition: 跨模型、会话或运行环境接续同一人格的身份、关系和可追溯历史。

en.name: Persona continuity
en.definition: Continuity of the same persona’s identity, relationships and traceable history across models, sessions and runtime environments.

zh.name: 授权边界
zh.definition: 现实动作要能追溯到当前授权来源、适用范围与执行记录。

en.name: Authorization boundary
en.definition: Real-world actions require a traceable source of current authorization, an explicit scope and an execution record.
